explanation: Benoist (arXiv:1602.07330, after Question 0.2): 'When n ≥ 2, the best known result is that n + 2 ≤ p(R(X1,...,Xn)) ≤ 2^n ... the lower bound is an easy consequence of the Cassels–Ellison–Pfister theorem'. The formal statement: for n ≥ 2 every p ∈ pythagorasBounds satisfies n + 2 ≤ p. Faithful.
